The '''Elus sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Feddasyr]].<ref name="EAOC" />

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[N'tain Xalis]] was assigned to Elus sector for a time during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
